name: exists_fixedPoint
statement: ContractingWith K f) (x : α) (hx : edist x (f x) ≠ ∞) : ∃ y, IsFixedPt f y ∧ Tendsto (fun n ↦ f^[n] x) atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, edist (f^[n] x) y ≤ edist x (f x) * (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n / (1 - K)

name: isFixedPt_fixedPoint_iterate
statement: ℕ} (hf : ContractingWith K f^[n]) : IsFixedPt f (hf.fixedPoint f^[n])
